description: Empirical power-density vs plasma-velocity lookup for a Faraday MHD channel. Breakpoints from P_density = sigma*u^2*B^2*K*(1-K) at sigma=10 S/m, B=5 T, K=0.5 (max-power load). Total power = density * channel volume (5x0.5x0.5 m).
source: Rosa, R.J. (1987) Magnetohydrodynamic Energy Conversion. McGraw-Hill; Way, S. et al. (1979) AIAA

sigma_plasma.note: Plasma electrical conductivity (reused from EC221 F1a)

K_load.note: Load factor at max power (reused from F1a)

lookup.note: Breakpoints: plasma flow velocity (m/s) -> electrical power density (W/m^3)

power_density_W_m3.note: 40 MW/m^3 at 800 m/s; ~50 MW total over the 1.25 m^3 channel
